title: VoteIt
tagline: Used to vote Suggestion on BLockchains and other information related to web3.
description:
This Project is On-Chain Voting. Used for voting Questions and Suggestions related to Blockchains. In this, Every member of this VoteIt can ask questions and Suggest changing anything in blockchain only.                                                              
The right to vote is to all users who want to vote but they can vote only by token VoteIt.
how_its_made:
This Project is done by combing fronted and backend. Fronted is made up of Html, CSS, javascript, and React framework.

The backend is made by writing smart contract, Hardhat is used to deploy smart contract and FVM blockchain is used to deploy this project. 
All data is store on inbuild BLockchain avaliblity in FVM.
